files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Added

- Solo 9×9 Sudoku with four difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard, expert).
- Server-side puzzle generation with a guaranteed unique solution; the solution
  never leaves the server.
- Three-mistakes-and-out gameplay with a visual life counter.
- Personal best time per user per level, with win-time comparison.
- Restart the same grid or start a new puzzle.
- Notes mode (pencil marks) with automatic clean-up of invalidated notes.
- Full keyboard play (arrows, 1–9, erase, toggle notes).
- Light/dark theme support, responsive layout, English and French translations.
